routes.observation: The official performance-measures page is live and states that FY2023, FY2024, and FY2025 data are preliminary pending final validation. It exposes performance-measure categories, including service-loss restoration and prevention, and links to dynamic warehouse reports.
routes.evidence_boundary: The route establishes current aggregate/state reporting availability, not a downloaded respondent or household longitudinal file.

routes.observation: The official landing page reports that preliminary FY2025 state data and grant-recipient profiles/performance-measure executive summaries were uploaded in July 2026.
routes.evidence_boundary: Availability of preliminary state summaries does not establish individual application, payment, reconnection, next-bill, or repeat-crisis outcomes.

routes.observation: HHS explains that restoration/prevention measures count occurrences for all LIHEAP-assisted households and distinguish bill-payment issues from equipment repair/replacement; routine maintenance without imminent service-loss risk is excluded.
routes.evidence_boundary: The definitions improve interpretation of the aggregate endpoint but do not identify the same household across episodes or measure restoration duration.

data_vintage_boundary: The site identifies FY2023, FY2024, and FY2025 performance-measure data as preliminary pending final validation; this recheck does not extract a state value or combine preliminary state rows into a national estimate.
next_decisive_route: Obtain an authorized state/grantee case or same-household event source with dated bill/notice, application, award or denial, receipt/reconnection, next bill, and repeat-crisis fields; do not treat the public warehouse as a person-level panel.
